milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The yellow concrete pillar is at spawn-relative (6-7, 0-2, 5). Target is set to the center of the pillar (6, 1, 5). From spawn (0,0,0) the horizontal distance is ~7.8 blocks, so with max_distance=5 the player MUST walk forward-right to get close enough. Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is actually looking at the yellow concrete.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The loom is at spawn-relative (-6, 0, 4) with decorative white wool blocks nearby. From spawn the horizontal distance is ~7.2 blocks, so with max_distance=5 the player MUST walk forward-left to get close enough. Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is actually looking at the loom.

Uses inventory_has because crafting red_wool (1 white_wool + 1 red_dye on crafting table at ~0,0,5) results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with white_wool and red_dye but NO red_wool, so any red_wool in inventory confirms successful crafting. This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The brick wall is at spawn-relative (-3 to 3, 0-2, -8 to -9), placed BEHIND spawn so it is NOT visible from the initial position. Target is the center of the wall (0, 1, -8). From spawn the horizontal distance is ~8 blocks, so with max_distance=5 the player MUST turn around 180° and walk backward (negative Z) to get close enough. Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is looking at the wall.
